Differentiate f(x) to get f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are the candidates for stationary points. Plug each x-value back into f(x) to find the corresponding y-values. Then, determine the nature of each point by using the second derivative test. If f''(x) is positive, it's a local minimum; negative, a local maximum; zero, inconclusive.
